verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes provides building blocks (persistent sessions, exec, file/watch APIs, tunnels) that a developer could use to build autonomous background agent workflows, and docs explicitly target 'AI agents that need to execute code.' However, there's no native scheduling/trigger mechanism for autonomous background runs, and community feedback notes containers auto-shutdown after idle requests with no built-in auto-destroy/cleanup controls, undermining true 'run autonomously in background' claims.
